lines.en: And-and-and, you know, if I get really hot,
um, I-I like to pick up this knife
and-and, um, I-I put the...
the cool steel against, um, my body.
Are you all right?
Yeah, yeah, I'm fine. It's...
What do we got here? 20-year-old male.
He's got a severed toe on his right foot.
Ow! Ow!
Could you please not do that feat first?
You know where his injury is.
Severed toe, you just said it!
It says here the knife went right through your shoe.
Of course it did. They're made of wicker.
Did you bring the toe?
Oh, yes, I have it right here on ice.
Don't worry, son. We'll just reattach it and then...
What? What is it?
You brought a carrot.
What?
This isn't your toe.
This is a small, very cold piece of carrot.
You brought a carrot?
What? Oh, my God.
There's a toe in my kitchen.
you
